newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mixed after late slip.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mixed after late slip.

text.p: Nov 20 - U.S. stock index futures closed mixed after a late decline erased an afternoon advance. Weakness in some technology stocks late, especially Microsoft one trader said, fueled late selling in S&P 500 futures. Earlier, firm bond prices and strength in NASDAQ stocks contributed to a rise to new all-time highs in December S&P 500s, they said. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
